title_en: Famous Chinese People (1/20): Yuan Longping, Father of Hybrid Rice
note_en: The text is full of passives with 被 (bèi): 被称为“杂交水稻之父” "is called the father of hybrid rice," 被分配到湖南的安江农校教书 "was assigned to teach at the Anjiang Agricultural School in Hunan." English needs "be" plus a past participle, but Chinese just puts 被 before an unchanged verb, and 被 can even follow another verb: 一个人值得被记住 "a person deserves to be remembered."
